reason: Almost all of the weight is National Insurance amendments that extend unemployment benefit eligibility: to the self-employed (1, 3, 5, 9), medical interns (4, 10, 11, 22, 40), people in vocational training (6, 8, 27), young people from age 18 or 19 (13, 14, 18, 19, 21, 26), parents who resign to care for a child, unpaid leave, and the first five days. All of these are 'cover more people', which is exactly what the statement asks, and the price (National Insurance spends more) is named. The only off-topic bills are light: the work grant (negative income tax) age bills (7, 31, 39, about 10 weight in total, which is in-work support rather than unemployment benefit) and the Employment Service public transport accessibility bills (23, 33).
